questions.question: Name the weaving technique that creates multicoloured designs in the / traditional kani shawl. a). Plain Weaving b). Twill Weaving c). Twill-tapestry weaving d). Satin Weaving

  • Stitch Description Effect

  • geometric patterns. Looks identical on both sides
  • Murgi- Resembles footsteps of a hen; a zig-zag running stitch Used to fill geometric motifs and appears as stepped lines
  • Negi- Ordinary running stitch worked in a darning pattern Used to create overall woven effect and fill large areas
  • Menthi- Cross stitch similar to Punjabi phulkari Used for filling motifs like flowers; done on a counted grid.
